body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose a 1-unit burst within 5 units. Enemies in the burst suffer -2 Movement while you maintain Concentration. Concentration: This ongoing effect lasts only while you maintain Concentration.

surges.html: If you voluntarily end this Concentration, its effect persists until the end of the current turn.
Increase the burst's radius by 1 unit.

rider.title: TIME THREAD
rider.html: After resolving this Action, create a Thread. Consume this Thread before resolving a future Magecraft Action that reduces Movement or changes timing to increase that effect by 1.
